endpoint_eligibility.allelic_direction: ineligible because REF and ALT share one coordinate score
endpoint_eligibility.graph_held_source_auprc: eligible retrospective development-only after source-independent locus and candidate construction
endpoint_eligibility.signed_cell_type_eqtl_effect: ineligible and prohibited from the primary leaderboard

current_coloc_gwas.allowed_use: Development-only locus and variant coordinates after corrected COLOC promotion. COLOC membership, posterior, candidate gene, and effect direction cannot alter TSS selection or distance.

gse244832.allowed_use: none required for distance computation; RNA, ATAC, donor labels, and same-sample different-aliquot topology are excluded from the baseline

gse281160.allowed_use: Development-only retrieval diagnostic on the precommitted locus and candidate roster. CROP-seq outcomes cannot choose a gene, transcript, TSS, anchor, or radius.
gse281160.warning: The 20 targets are MPRA-selected and do not form an unbiased external source.

gse281364.allowed_use: Development-only retrieval diagnostic. MPRA activity and reporter-gene design cannot choose the nearest endogenous gene or distance definition.

gse289173.allowed_use: One-time unsigned scoring of anonymized selection-locked variant-gene rows after the TSS artifact and algorithm are hashed. eQTL and interaction-eQTL effects, labels, lineages, calibration, and candidate construction remain evaluator-only.

gse296875.allowed_use: none required for distance computation; same-nucleus RNA, ATAC, donor, pathology, and QTL outcomes are excluded

gencode_v49.allowed_use: Frozen development-built transcript TSS annotation only
gencode_v49.warning: Later annotation releases, browser canonical transcript choices, gene symbols, and online lookups are prohibited after the TSS artifact freeze.

resource_gene_catalog_current.allowed_use: No Gene Catalog membership, evidence class, threshold, program, hero-gene status, or source finding may choose candidate genes or TSSs.

graph_held_source_protocol.candidate_universe: Freeze genes and locus variants independently of the removed source. A source-only assayed gene or variant remains evaluator-only.
graph_held_source_protocol.distance_input: Use only frozen coordinates and GENCODE TSSs. Held-source observability, positive/tested-negative status, provenance, and outcome are unavailable to the scorer.
graph_held_source_protocol.locus_aggregation: For each candidate gene, use the minimum TSS distance over the precommitted remaining-source or source-independent locus variant roster.
graph_held_source_protocol.removal: Remove any held-source-selected lead variant, credible-set member, locus boundary, gene, transcript, or candidate row before distance aggregation.
graph_held_source_protocol.seal_status: No graph source is sealed; a leakage-safe result remains retrospective.

variant_and_ld_leakage_contract.candidate_pairs: The evaluator or a pre-seal development artifact supplies the complete pair denominator. Positive eQTL pairs cannot define which genes are scored.
variant_and_ld_leakage_contract.duplicate_variants: Exact, near-identical, reverse-complement, and LD-linked variants stay in one outer role and do not count as independent retrieval examples.
variant_and_ld_leakage_contract.liftover: Compute ancestry-matched LD on native build before liftover. Only unique one-to-one GRCh38.p14 mappings with REF match receive distances.
variant_and_ld_leakage_contract.locus_grouping: Merge variants within 1 Mb or r2>=0.8 in any represented ancestry before split; retain locus IDs in predictions and bootstrap LD blocks.
variant_and_ld_leakage_contract.no_sign: Distance contains no allele, lineage, donor, or effect-direction information. Never multiply proximity by a held eQTL beta or infer sign from the nearest gene.

observability_and_degree_audit.gene_density: Dense gene regions make nearest-TSS retrieval easier and create many close alternatives. Report distance and candidate-count strata.
observability_and_degree_audit.held_observability: Do not use which genes have eQTL, MPRA, CROP-seq, or graph measurements to define candidates or ties.
observability_and_degree_audit.locus_size: Report candidate denominator and number of variants per locus; large loci and credible sets can reduce minimum distances by construction.
observability_and_degree_audit.tie_rule: Preserve equal distance scores. Evaluator tie handling is frozen independently of labels.

reproducibility_contract.annotation_receipt: Hash source GTF, contig filter, parsed transcript TSS table, gene-version crosswalk, strand fixtures, and rejected records.
reproducibility_contract.prediction_receipt: Hash candidate table, normalized/lifted coordinates, LD and locus assignments, TSS join, distances, locus aggregation, ties, row order, and output.
reproducibility_contract.unit_of_inference: independent locus; variants, candidate genes, transcripts, TSSs, cells, and seeds are not independent replicates
